messages:
ops-oncall: Incident: Dedicated pool (us-west-2-reserved) p95 token latency jumped ~4-6x and throughput dropped ~35% since 12:10 UTC. SLA alert fired. Anyone oncall for runtime/placement?
alyssa: I'm on. Seeing increased queueing in front of runtime, multiple long tails on generate requests.
devon: Looking at placement logs — a sudden influx of on-demand inference jobs got routed to the reserved pool at 12:08 due to a quota reconciliation job. suspect quota misconfig.
mira: Confirming — quota-service rolled a change at 12:05 that briefly set reserved_pool.allowed_shared = true for a subset of tenancy IDs. Patch rolled at 12:07 but some sessions continued.
ops-oncall: @alyssa @devon can we triage kernel selection/queueing? Could noisy neighbor (big-batch jobs) be starving KV cache or impacting batching heuristics?
alyssa: Profiling runtime: kernel selector logged a lot of fallbacks to generic kernels around 12:09. Quote from logs: `kernel_select: model=redwood-7b, requested=qint8-fused-attn, fallback=generic_attention, reason=unsupported_qint8_fused_op`
alyssa: When kernel falls back, token compute jumps ~3.5x on these GPUs (seen in perf counters).
devon: Also seeing batching heuristic thrash: small concurrent sessions got grouped into one huge batch because `prefix_affinity` tagging failed for cached contexts. KV cache hits dropped ~18% after 12:06.
mira: So chain: quota change -> extra on-demand jobs land on reserved nodes -> those jobs use models/configs that trigger kernel fallback on our quantized path -> slow kernels + batching heuristic grouping -> KV cache effectiveness down -> higher lat/queue.
sre-bot: nvidia-smi snapshot: gpu0..3 utilization 95-100%, memory pinned at ~98%.
ops-oncall: Good summary. Immediate mitigation options?
devon: 1) Revoke the temporary quota change (already done). 2) Evacuate on-demand containers off reserved pool (start drain). 3) Force fallback to compatible model variant that has optimized kernels (hotfix routing). 4) Tighten batching window to stop mega-batching until KV tagging fix.
alyssa: I'm patching runtime to reject unsupported qint8-fused requests on reserved pool, routing them to hosted pool instead. Pushing canary in 2 nodes now.
deploy-bot: deploy requested by alyssa: runtime/route-guard v2 -> canary (2 nodes).
mira: We're also rolling back the quota service change to the pre-12:05 behavior. That should stop new shared placements.
ops-oncall: Any long-term fixes to avoid recurrence?
devon: - Add guardrails in placement scheduler to never route on-demand into fully reserved pools when allowed_shared flips transiently.
devon: - Runtime: improve kernel selection pre-flight: validate model build flags vs compiled kernels before accepting requests (cheap check).
alyssa: - KV cache: add stronger context hashing/tagging so prefix_affinity doesn't miss cached contexts under concurrent reconnects. I've got a PR: `kv-tag-fix-2025` (draft).
mira: - Quota service: publish a canary policy that requires a two-step roll for pool membership changes.
ops-oncall: Actions taken: 1) quota rollback at 12:15, 2) runtime route guard canary at 12:22 on 2 nodes, 3) started draining 8 containers of on-demand at 12:28, 4) temporary increase of reserved pool burst capacity by 10% at 12:35.
sre-bot: p95 latency graph: peaked at 12:12, trending down after 12:30, current p95 ~1.3x baseline.
alyssa: Canary looks good, kernel fallback occurrences dropped 90% on canary nodes. Will promote route-guard to full pool next 10m if no regressions.
devon: After drains, on-demand share on reserved pool fell from 21% to 2%. Throughput recovering.
ops-oncall: Are there customer-facing SLAs we need to notify?
mira: Yes — two enterprise customers hit error budget thresholds. CS notified and drafting email. Not a full breach yet, but under investigation.
ops-oncall: OK — keep this thread updated. Next steps: promote canary, merge kv-tag PR after tests, place permanent placement guard, postmortem to include timeline and root cause (quota + kernel mismatch + batching heuristics + KV tagging).
alyssa: I'll attach perf traces and kernel selection logs to the postmortem doc once cleaned.
devon: I'll add placement audit logs and quota rollout diff.
mira: CS will collect impacted tenant IDs and notify legal/enterprise team.
ops-oncall: Marking incident as mitigated at 12:50 UTC — monitoring for 3h. If regressions reappear reopen. :white_check_mark:
alyssa: Thanks all.
ops-oncall: closing thread in 3h if stable.
